items.title: M0: red evidence smoke proving PBP-882 lacks capability lineage
items.context: Read-only smoke loading .lattice/artifact-releases.jsonl, playbooks.json, playbook-promotion-health.jsonl; asserts B-785e artifact release exists AND candidate lineage lacks capabilityReleaseId/artifactReleaseId. Fails RED on current state; passes once M4/M8 land.
items.userSees: product-capability-release-red-smoke fails RED: expected PCR-<id>, actual undefined (candidate lacks capability lineage; green after M4)

happy.desc: Hermetic mkdtemp fixture with a B-785e-shaped artifact release + PCR + a candidate playbook proves the candidate lineage lacks capabilityReleaseId; the smoke asserts the desired bound state and fails RED.

edge.desc: The smoke reads NO live repo-root .lattice; it is re-runnable and does not self-invalidate against the backfill proof.

adversarial.desc: The expected PCR id is produced by the real M1 record builder (not hand-faked); the red is a genuine gap and flips green when M4 binds lineage on the same fixture.

verificationEvidence.note: Hermetic red smoke now passes via the real M4 enrichment path, proving the gap is closed on the fixture.
Smoke uses a mkdtemp fixture, reads no live repo-root .lattice, and is re-runnable.
Expected PCR id is produced by the real M1 builder; red before M4, green after — a genuine red->green pin.

items.title: M1: ProductCapabilityReleaseRecord schema + capability-releases.jsonl ledger
items.context: New core/capability-release.ts mirroring artifact-release.ts: schemaVersion proofbound.product-capability-release.v1, parse/read/append, capabilityDigest, idempotency key, malformed-row rejection, authority=non_authoritative, gateEvidence=false, activationBoundary.

happy.desc: core/capability-release.ts builds a ProductCapabilityReleaseRecord with a deterministic merge-stable capabilityDigest, PCR-<24hex> id, digest-derived 12-hex capabilityVersion, and host-neutral capabilityId slug; smoke green.

edge.desc: The fail-closed reader throws CapabilityReleaseLedgerError on authority!==non_authoritative, gateEvidence!==false, and malformed JSON; artifact-less digest is stable.

adversarial.desc: idempotencyKey excludes mainCommit so a recovery re-merge with a different mainCommit yields the SAME id; a gate-import guard proves no gate/DONE/validate/delivery module imports the reader.

verificationEvidence.note: Deterministic merge-stable capabilityDigest, PCR-<24hex> id, digest-derived version, capabilityId slug — all green.
Fail-closed reader throws on authority/gateEvidence/malformed rows; artifact-less digest stable.
idempotencyKey excludes mainCommit (recovery -> same id); gate-import guard proves no gate module imports the reader.

items.title: M2: conservative DONE capability classifier
items.context: Classify changed docs/experiments into capabilityKind or no-release. Conservative: uncertain -> no release + advisory. Fixtures: B-785e-like experiment-launch-control, plain doc (none), runtime code (none), .lattice/story metadata (none).
items.userSees: capability classifier fixtures green; classifier invoked from both DONE completion sites

happy.desc: A pure core/ classifier (mirroring selectArtifactReleasePathsV1) returns experiment-launch-control for B-785e-like experiment/doc paths and produces the capability-declaring path subset.

edge.desc: Plain typo-only docs, packages/main/src runtime code, and .lattice/story metadata-only changes classify as NO capability release; uncertain cases record nothing and emit an advisory.

adversarial.desc: Both DONE sites (done-effects.ts:1167 and done-recover.ts:116) import and invoke the SAME core classifier so the recover path cannot silently diverge from the normal path.

verificationEvidence.note: Pure classifyCapabilityRelease returns experiment-launch-control for B-785e-like paths + the capability path subset.
Typo-doc -> documentation-control; runtime src / .lattice metadata -> no capability release.
Both DONE sites (done-effects.ts:1167, done-recover.ts:116) import the same core classifier.

items.title: M3: deterministic idempotent release binding in DONE post-merge
items.context: Bind storyId, mainCommit, artifactReleaseId, artifactSetDigest, capabilityId, capabilityVersion, capabilityDigest. Idempotency key storyId+mainCommit+capabilityDigest+artifactSetDigest; no duplicate on DONE recovery/retry.
items.userSees: .lattice/capability-releases.jsonl contains one PCR row after DONE; re-run reports already_recorded

happy.desc: On DONE merge a capability release is recorded binding storyId, mainCommit (provenance), artifactReleaseId/artifactSetDigest when present, capabilityDigest, and the full changedPaths.

edge.desc: Re-running the binding with a DIFFERENT mainCommit returns already_recorded and does not append a duplicate row (merge-stable recovery dedup).

adversarial.desc: The ledger is committed via git add -f with a .gitignore un-ignore rule so it is tracked (cross-host source of truth), not host-local.

verificationEvidence.note: DONE records one PCR row binding storyId/mainCommit/artifact ids/changedPaths.
Re-run with a different mainCommit returns already_recorded; no duplicate row.
Ledger committed via git add -f + .gitignore un-ignore -> tracked cross-host source of truth.

items.title: M4: DONE candidate ingest attaches capability lineage
items.context: When a capability release exists for the story, candidate lineage gains capabilityReleaseId, capabilityId, capabilityVersion, artifactReleaseId, artifactSetDigest. Existing candidates without it stay valid but reported under-bound.
items.userSees: product-capability-release-red-smoke now PASSES green; playbook-capability-lineage-smoke green

happy.desc: DONE candidate ingest attaches optional lineage.capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId/capabilityVersion/artifactReleaseId when a capability release exists for the story.

edge.desc: A pre-existing 3-field PlaybookLineage still parses (new fields optional); re-applying enrichment is a no-op keyed on the stable source key, not digest equality.

adversarial.desc: Enrichment recomputes proposal/playbook digests without tripping stale-proposal rejection; the M0 red fixture, run through the real enrichment, now flips green.

verificationEvidence.note: Candidate ingest attaches capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId/version/artifactReleaseId when a capability release exists.
Pre-existing 3-field lineage still parses; re-apply is a no-op keyed on the canonical source key.
Enrichment recomputes proposal/playbook digests without tripping stale-proposal; the M0 red fixture flips green.

items.title: M6 assert: candidate capability playbook is excluded from active runtime surfacing
items.context: Regression-proof the ALREADY-enforced invariant: matchActivePlaybook (core/playbook-runtime-memory.ts:343) returns null unless status===active, so a status=candidate capability playbook never enters MemoryFreshnessPack.results.playbookIds. Assert-only; no new mechanism.
items.userSees: capability-release-invariants-smoke: candidate excluded from active surfacing (green)

happy.desc: A status=candidate capability playbook is excluded by matchActivePlaybook (playbook-runtime-memory.ts:343) and never appears in active surfacing.

edge.desc: The candidate does not enter MemoryFreshnessPack.results.playbookIds.

adversarial.desc: Only status===active playbooks match; flipping status to active would surface it, proving the guard is the actual gate (no new mechanism built).

Candidate does not enter active playbookIds.
